core_obligations: Allowing the beam to touch the cavity bottom creates degenerating moving fluid domains. The author uses a contact-adapted coupled weak formulation, vanishing structural-viscosity approximations, strong velocity compactness and carefully approximated test functions to pass the nonlinear fluid-beam interaction to a global energy solution.
